title: Predicting gene expression from DNA sequence using deep learning models.
authors: Barbadilla-Martinez, Lucia; Klaassen, Noud; van Steensel, Bas; de Ridder, Jeroen
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了用深度学习从DNA序列预测基因表达，核心涉及转录因子调控元件，但偏重综述而非具体TF-DNA互作建模，方法可借鉴。
abstract: Transcription of genes is regulated by DNA elements such as promoters and enhancers, the activity of which are in turn controlled by many transcription factors. Owing to the highly complex combinatorial logic involved, it has been difficult to construct computational models that predict gene activity from DNA sequence. Recent advances in deep learning techniques applied to data from epigenome mapping and high-throughput reporter assays have made substantial progress towards addressing this complexity. Such models can capture the regulatory grammar with remarkable accuracy and show great promise in predicting the effects of non-coding variants, uncovering detailed molecular mechanisms of gene regulation and designing synthetic regulatory elements for biotechnology. Here, we discuss the principles of these approaches, the types of training data sets that are available and the strengths and limitations of different approaches.
abstract_zh: 基因的转录受到启动子和增强子等DNA元件的调控，而这些元件的活性又受众多转录因子的控制。由于涉及高度复杂的组合逻辑，构建从DNA序列预测基因活性的计算模型一直颇具挑战。近年来，深度学习技术在表观基因组图谱和高通量报告基因检测数据上的应用，在应对这一复杂性方面取得了显著进展。此类模型能够以惊人的准确性捕捉调控语法，并在预测非编码变异效应、揭示基因调控的详细分子机制以及设计用于生物技术的合成调控元件方面展现出巨大潜力。在此，我们讨论这些方法的原理、可用的训练数据集类型，以及不同方法的优势与局限性。
